detect.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）

diet.sentenceEn: No matter how you "enhance" enclosures, they do not allow for freedom, a natural diet or adequate exercise.
diet.translationZh: 无论你如何“改善”圈养环境，它们都无法提供自由、自然饮食或充足的活动空间。
diet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

diet.sentenceEn: The two highly recommended lifestyle approaches are maintaining or increasing your level of aerobic exercise and following a Mediterranean-style diet that is high in fiber and eliminates highly processed foods.
diet.translationZh: 两种高度推荐的生活方式是保持或增加有氧运动水平，以及遵循地中海式饮食——这种饮食富含纤维并排除高度加工食品。
diet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

diet.sentenceEn: But switching to a mainly plant-based diet wouldn't help.
diet.translationZh: 但是转向以植物为主的饮食也无济于事。
diet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

diet.sentenceEn: And perhaps faintly, they hint that people should look to intangible qualities like character and intellect rather than dieting their way to size zero or wasp-waist physiques.
diet.translationZh: 或许这些举措还隐晦地暗示，人们应当注重性格和智力等无形品质，而非通过节食追求零号身材或蜂腰体型。
diet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

diet.sentenceEn: Stop laughing: it's not just cost effective but helps you balance your diet .
diet.translationZh: 别笑：这不仅省钱，还能帮你均衡饮食。
diet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

diet.translationZh: 有关节食的网站将会蓬勃发展。

discipline.sentenceEn: So when young people are critical of an over-tweeting president, they reveal a mental discipline in thinking skills – and in their choices on when to share on social media.
discipline.translationZh: 因此，当年轻人对过度使用推特的总统提出批评时，他们展现出了思维能力方面的自律——以及在决定何时在社交媒体上分享信息时的自律。
discipline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

discipline.sentenceEn: No disciplines have seized on professionalism with as much enthusiasm as the humanities.
discipline.translationZh: 在所有学科中，人文学科对专业化的追求最为狂热。

discipline.sentenceEn: So disciplines acquire a monopoly not just over the production of knowledge, but also over the production of the producers of knowledge.
discipline.translationZh: 因此，各学科不仅垄断了知识的生产，还垄断了知识生产者的培养。

discipline.sentenceEn: These are disciplines that are going out of style: 22% of American college graduates now major in business compared with only 2% in history and 4% in English.
discipline.translationZh: 这些学科正逐渐过时：如今22%的美国大学毕业生主修商科，相比之下，只有2%主修历史，4%主修英语。

discipline.sentenceEn: Markets have lost faith that the euro zone's economies, weaker or stronger, will one day converge thanks to the discipline of sharing a single currency, which denies uncompetitive members the quick fix of devaluation.
discipline.translationZh: 市场已经失去信心，不再相信欧元区经济体——无论强弱——会因为共用单一货币的约束而有朝一日实现趋同，因为单一货币制度使缺乏竞争力的成员国无法通过货币贬值这一捷径来解决问题。
discipline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

discipline.sentenceEn: The study of law has been recognized for centuries as a basic intellectual discipline in European universities.
discipline.translationZh: 几个世纪以来，法律研究在欧洲大学中一直被视为一门基础的知识学科。
discipline.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
discipline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

discrimination.sentenceEn: Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination , courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection".
discrimination.translationZh: 由于加州这项法律适用于所有董事会，甚至包括那些从未有过歧视历史的董事会，法院很可能会裁定该法律违反了宪法保障的“平等保护”原则。
discrimination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

discrimination.sentenceEn: The Taylor decision also declared sex discrimination in jury selection to be unconstitutional and ordered states to use the same procedures for selecting male and female jurors.
discrimination.translationZh: 泰勒案的判决还宣布在陪审团遴选中存在性别歧视是违宪的，并命令各州在遴选男性和女性陪审员时采用相同的程序。
discrimination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

discrimination.sentenceEn: Although the Supreme Court of the United States had prohibited intentional racial discrimination in jury selection as early as the 1880 case of Strauder v. West Virginia, the practice of selecting so-called elite or blue-ribbon juries provided a convenient way around this and other antidiscrimination laws.
discrimination.translationZh: 尽管美国最高法院早在1880年Strauder诉西弗吉尼亚州一案中就禁止了陪审团遴选过程中蓄意的种族歧视，但挑选所谓精英陪审团或蓝带陪审团的做法却为规避这一规定及其他反歧视法律提供了便利途径。
discrimination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

discrimination.sentenceEn: Over the past century, all kinds of unfairness and discrimination have been condemned or made illegal.
discrimination.translationZh: 在过去的一个世纪里，各种不公平和歧视行为都受到了谴责或被列为非法。
discrimination.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
discrimination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

discrimination.sentenceEn: This, for those as yet unaware of such a disadvantage, refers to discrimination against those whose surnames begin with a letter in the lower half of the alphabet.
discrimination.translationZh: 对于那些尚未意识到这种劣势的人来说，它指的是对那些姓氏以字母表后半部分字母开头的人的歧视。
discrimination.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
discrimination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

discrimination.sentenceEn: Some form of discrimination is too subtle to recognize.
discrimination.translationZh: 某些形式的歧视过于微妙，难以察觉。
discrimination.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）

dispute.sentenceEn: The number of libraries that have closed since 2010 is disputed .
dispute.translationZh: 自2010年以来关闭的图书馆数量尚存争议。
dispute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

dispute.sentenceEn: Most scientists and experts sharply dispute Hardy's views.
dispute.translationZh: 大多数科学家和专家对哈迪的观点提出了尖锐的反驳。
dispute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

dispute.sentenceEn: Big-name PRH authors may suffer a bit, but it's those mid-list authors, who normally rely on Waterstones staff's passion for promoting books by lesser-known writers, who will be praying for an end to the dispute .
dispute.translationZh: 企鹅兰登书屋的知名作家可能会受到些许影响，但真正盼望这场争端结束的，是那些中游作家——他们通常依赖水石书店员工对推广小众作家作品的热情。
dispute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

dispute.sentenceEn: Another factor may be that more people are trying to overpack their carry-on bags to avoid checked-baggage fees, though the airlines strongly dispute this.
dispute.translationZh: 另一个因素可能是，越来越多的乘客试图在随身行李中塞入过多物品，以规避托运行李费用，不过航空公司对此表示强烈否认。
dispute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

dispute.sentenceEn: What can be one consequence of the current dispute ?
dispute.translationZh: 当前这场争端可能带来什么后果？

dispute.sentenceEn: Their legitimacy has long been in dispute .
dispute.translationZh: 其合理性长期以来一直存在争议。

diversity.sentenceEn: Asia is arguably the region most neglected by global efforts to increase diversity in restoration and to study native species.
diversity.translationZh: 亚洲可以说是在提高恢复多样性和研究本土物种的全球努力中，最被忽视的地区。
diversity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

diversity.sentenceEn: The publishing industry talks about diversity in terms of authors and staff but it also needs a plurality of ways of delivering intellectual contact, choice and different voices.
diversity.translationZh: 出版业在谈论作者和员工的多样性，但它也需要多种方式来实现知识交流、提供选择和展现不同声音。
diversity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

diversity.sentenceEn: It has been estimated that this generation, due to the pressures of technology, the wish for personal fulfilment and desire for diversity , will work for 17 different employers over the course of their working life and have five different careers.
diversity.translationZh: 据估计，由于技术发展的压力、对个人成就感的追求以及对多元化的渴望，这一代人在其职业生涯中将为17个不同的雇主工作，并从事5种不同的职业。
diversity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

diversity.sentenceEn: Progressives often support diversity mandates as a path to equality and a way to level the playing field.
diversity.translationZh: 进步派常常支持多元化指令，将其视为实现平等和创造公平竞争环境的途径。
diversity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

diversity.sentenceEn: When education becomes one-size-fits-all, it risks overlooking a nation's diversity of gifts.
diversity.translationZh: 当教育变成一刀切的模式时，就可能忽视一个国家人民天赋的多样性。
diversity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

diversity.sentenceEn: There is no doubt that gardens evidence an irrepressible urge to create, express, fashion, and beautify and that self-expression is a basic human urge; yet when one looks at the photographs of the gardens created by the homeless, it strikes one that, for all their diversity of styles, these gardens speak of various other fundamental urges, beyond that of decoration and creative expression.
diversity.translationZh: 毫无疑问，花园证明了人类内心深处一种难以抑制的冲动——创造、表达、塑造与美化的冲动，而自我表达无疑是人类的基本欲望之一。然而，当我们观看那些无家可归者所创造的花园照片时，我们会突然意识到，尽管这些花园风格各异，但它们所体现的不仅仅是装饰和创造性表达的欲望，还蕴含着其他各种基本的人类渴望。
diversity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

domestic.sentenceEn: "For decades we have not taken responsibility for investing in our domestic wood supply, leaving us exposed to fluctuating prices and fighting for future supplies of wood as global demand rises and our own supplies fall."
domestic.translationZh: 几十年来，我们一直未能承担起投资国内木材供应的责任，这使我们面临价格波动的风险，并且随着全球需求上升而我们自身供应下降，我们还将为未来的木材供应而竞争。
domestic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

domestic.sentenceEn: First two hours, now three hours – this is how far in advance authorities are recommending people show up to catch a domestic flight, at least at some major U.S. airports with increasingly massive security lines.
domestic.translationZh: 先是两小时，现在是三小时——这是当局建议人们为搭乘国内航班提前到达机场的时间，至少在一些安检队伍日益庞大的美国主要机场是如此。
domestic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

domestic.sentenceEn: Children were not colour-coded at all until the early 20th century: in the era before domestic washing machines all babies wore white as a practical matter, since the only way of getting clothes clean was to boil them.
domestic.translationZh: 直到20世纪初，儿童服装才开始有了颜色区分：在家用洗衣机问世之前的年代，所有婴儿实际上都穿白色衣服，因为当时唯一能把衣服洗干净的方法就是煮沸。
domestic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

domestic.sentenceEn: At any rate, this change will ultimately be acclaimed by an ever-growing number of both domestic and international consumers, regardless of how long the current consumer pattern will take hold.
domestic.translationZh: 无论如何，这一变化最终将受到越来越多国内外消费者的欢迎，不管当前的消费模式能持续多久。

domestic.sentenceEn: The kinds of interpersonal violence that women are exposed to tend to be in domestic situations, by, unfortunately, parents or other family members, and they tend not to be one-shot deals.
domestic.translationZh: 不幸的是，女性遭受的人际暴力往往发生在家庭环境中，施暴者多为父母或其他家庭成员，而且这些暴力行为往往不是一次性的。
domestic.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
domestic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

domestic.sentenceEn: Foreign-made cars and textiles were sweeping into the domestic market.
domestic.translationZh: 外国制造的汽车和纺织品正席卷国内市场。
domestic.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
domestic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

dominant.sentenceEn: When it was established, the National Health Service (NHS) was visionary: offering high-quality, timely care to meet the dominant needs of the population it served.
dominant.translationZh: 英国国家医疗服务体系(NHS)成立之初便极具远见：提供高质量、及时的医疗服务，以满足其所服务人群的主要需求。
dominant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

dominant.sentenceEn: First, it is very expensive to set up the computer, card reader, and telecommunications networks necessary to make electronic money the dominant form of payment.
dominant.translationZh: 首先，建立使电子货币成为主要支付方式所必需的计算机、读卡器和电信网络成本高昂。
dominant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

dominant.sentenceEn: It was not until the mid-1980s, when amplifying age and sex differences became a dominant children's marketing strategy, that pink fully came into its own, when it began to seem inherently attractive to girls, part of what defined them as female, at least for the first few critical years.
dominant.translationZh: 直到20世纪80年代中期，当放大年龄和性别差异成为儿童市场的主导营销策略时，粉色才真正盛行起来，并开始对女孩产生一种天生的吸引力，成为定义她们女性身份的一部分，至少在最初关键的几年里是如此。
dominant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

dominant.sentenceEn: It is stuck because the euro zone's dominant powers, France and Germany, agree on the need for greater harmonisation within the euro zone, but disagree about what to harmonise.
dominant.translationZh: 之所以陷入僵局，是因为欧元区的主导国家法国和德国虽然一致认为有必要在欧元区内加强协调，但在协调什么内容的问题上却存在分歧。
dominant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

dominant.sentenceEn: According to many books and articles, New England's leaders established the basic themes and preoccupations of an unfolding, dominant Puritan tradition in American intellectual life.
dominant.translationZh: 据许多书籍和文章记载，新英格兰的领袖们确立了美国思想生活中一种正在形成的、占主导地位的清教传统的基本主题和关注焦点。
dominant.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
dominant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

dominant.sentenceEn: The Administration is dominant over immigration issues.
dominant.translationZh: 联邦政府在移民事务上拥有主导权。

draft.sentenceEn: Once you have a first draft on paper, you can delete material that is unrelated to your thesis and add material necessary to illustrate your points and make your paper convincing.
draft.translationZh: 一旦你完成了初稿，就可以删除与论文主题无关的内容，并添加必要的材料来阐明你的观点，使论文更具说服力。
draft.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
draft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

draft.sentenceEn: If a relevant and important idea occurs to you now, work it into the draft .
draft.translationZh: 如果此刻你想到一个相关且重要的观点，就把它融入草稿中。
draft.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
draft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

draft.sentenceEn: Remember that your initial draft is only that.
draft.translationZh: 记住，你的初稿仅仅是初稿而已。
draft.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
draft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

draft.sentenceEn: The first draft will appear on the page only if you stop avoiding the inevitable and sit, stand up, or lie down to write.
draft.translationZh: 只有当你不再逃避写作这一必然任务，无论坐下、站着还是躺着开始动笔，初稿才会跃然纸上。
draft.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
draft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

draft.sentenceEn: In a significant tightening of legal controls over the press, Lord Irvine, the Lord Chancellor, will introduce a draft bill that will propose making payments to witnesses illegal and will strictly control the amount of publicity that can be given to a case before a trial begins.
draft.translationZh: 为显著加强对新闻媒体的法律监管，大法官欧文勋爵将提出一项草案，该草案将提议把向证人付费定为非法行为，并将严格控制案件在开庭审理前的公开程度。
draft.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
draft.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

draft.sentenceEn: It's worth remembering, however, that though a clean copy fresh off a printer may look terrific, it will read only as well as the thinking and writing that have gone into it. Many writers prudently store their data on disks and print their pages each time they finish a draft to avoid losing any material because of power failures or other problems.
draft.translationZh: 然而，值得记住的是，尽管刚从打印机上输出的干净稿件看起来可能很棒，但它的可读性只取决于稿件背后的思考和写作质量。许多作家会谨慎地将数据存储在磁盘上，并在每次完成一稿后打印出来，以避免因停电或其他问题而丢失任何材料。
draft.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

definition.sentenceEn: Tracing the history of the term, we can see how the definition of scientific literacy has shifted over time, muddying the waters when it comes to determining the goals of science education.
definition.translationZh: 追溯该术语的历史可以发现，科学素养的定义随着时间的推移发生了变化，这使得在确定科学教育的目标时，情况变得更加复杂且模糊不清。
definition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

definition.sentenceEn: Now that members of Generation Z are graduating college this spring—the most commonly-accepted definition says this generation was born after 1995, give or take a year—the attention has been rising steadily in recent weeks.
definition.translationZh: 今年春季，Z世代成员即将大学毕业——最普遍接受的定义是这一代人出生于1995年之后，前后误差不超过一年——近几周来，人们对他们的关注度稳步上升。
definition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

definition.sentenceEn: We need to look beyond strict definitions of legal and illegal.
definition.translationZh: 我们需要超越对合法与非法的严格定义。
definition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

definition.sentenceEn: My definition revolves around the concept of "stickiness" – creations and experiences to which others adhere.
definition.translationZh: 我对这个概念的定义围绕着“粘性”展开——即能让他人产生共鸣并沉浸其中的创作和体验。
definition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

definition.sentenceEn: First, the object of our study pleads for definition .
definition.translationZh: 首先，我们研究的对象亟待定义。
definition.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
definition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

definition.sentenceEn: The definition also excludes the majority of teachers, despite the fact that teaching has traditionally been the method whereby many intellectuals earn their living.
definition.translationZh: 这一定义也将大多数教师排除在外，尽管传统上许多知识分子都以教书为生。
definition.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
definition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

delay.sentenceEn: Disruptions have become increasingly frequent with train delays now a fixture in Italian media coverage.
delay.translationZh: 交通中断已变得日益频繁，火车晚期现已成为意大利媒体报道中的常态。
delay.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

delay.sentenceEn: This is why the recent severe delays caused by numerous maintenance works have thrown the rail industry into chaos at a time when most people head on holiday, which matters for business in a country where tourism accounts for 10 percent of GDP.
delay.translationZh: 近期，频繁的维护工程导致了严重的延误。时值大众休假出行的高峰期，这使得铁路行业陷入混乱。对于旅游业贡献了10%国内生产总值的国家而言，这直接影响到了国家的经济。
delay.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

delay.sentenceEn: This suggests the possibility that lifestyle factors might help prevent or delay this type of decline.
delay.translationZh: 这表明生活方式因素可能有助于预防或延缓这类衰退。
delay.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

delay.sentenceEn: Typically, if rains are delayed , people may clear land to plant more rice to supplement their harvests.
delay.translationZh: 通常情况下，如果降雨推迟，人们可能会开垦土地来种植更多水稻以补充收成。
delay.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

delay.sentenceEn: It's also a good idea to delay the conversation if you are in a meeting or other public space.
delay.translationZh: 如果你正在开会或身处其他公共场合，最好也推迟讨论。
delay.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

delay.sentenceEn: Starting next year, any guaranteed bonus of top executives could be delayed 10 years if their banks are under investigation for wrongdoing.
delay.translationZh: 从明年开始，若银行因不当行为正在接受调查，高管的任何保障性奖金都可能被推迟10年发放。
delay.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

desperate.sentenceEn: Christopher Kettle, Biodiversity International's director for forest genetic resources and restoration in Rome, says that the need for infrastructure — things such as mechanisms for collecting and storing seeds, and nurseries to raise seedlings — might be most desperate here because many trees are 'masting' species, which don't produce seeds every year.
desperate.translationZh: 位于罗马的国际生物多样性中心森林遗传资源与修复主管克里斯托弗·凯特尔表示，这里对基础设施（如种子采集和储存机制，以及培育幼苗的苗圃）的需求最为迫切，因为许多树木属于“大年结实”物种，并不会每年都产种。
desperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

desperate.sentenceEn: The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research; both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them.
desperate.translationZh: 荷兰出版巨头爱思唯尔(Elsevier)声称出版了全球25%的科学论文，去年利润超过9亿英镑；而仅英国的大学在2016年就花费了超过2.1亿英镑，以使研究人员能够获取他们自己的公共资助研究成果。尽管人们愈发迫切地试图改变这种局面，但这两个数字似乎都在持续上涨，势不可挡。
desperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

desperate.sentenceEn: "The lesser prairie chicken is in a desperate situation," said USFWS Director Daniel Ashe.
desperate.translationZh: 美国鱼类和野生动物管理局局长丹尼尔·阿什表示：“小草原松鸡正处于危急关头。”
desperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

desperate.sentenceEn: Nevertheless, the affordable housing situation is desperate .
desperate.translationZh: 然而，经济适用房的形势却十分严峻。
desperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

desperate.sentenceEn: Instead, the company has done precisely what it had long promised it would not: challenge the constitutionality of Vermont's rules in the federal court, as part of a desperate effort to keep its Vermont Yankee nuclear power plant running.
desperate.translationZh: 然而，该公司恰恰做了它长期以来承诺绝不会做的事：在联邦法院质疑佛蒙特州相关规定的合宪性，这是其为维持佛蒙特扬基核电站运营所做的孤注一掷的努力。
desperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

desperate.sentenceEn: Yet these desperate measures have proved the right ones and, sadly for many journalists, they can be pushed further.
desperate.translationZh: 然而，事实证明这些孤注一掷的措施是正确的，而对许多记者而言不幸的是，这些措施还可以进一步推进。
desperate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

depression.sentenceEn: Chaudhary said that parents now had less childcare support from family and social networks than during most of humans' evolutionary history, but introducing additional caregivers could reduce stress and maternal depression , which could have a "knock-on" benefit to a child's wellbeing.
depression.translationZh: 乔杜里指出，与人类进化史的大部分时期相比，如今的父母从家庭和社交网络获得的育儿支持更少。但增加额外的照料者可以减轻压力和母亲抑郁，这可能对孩子的福祉产生'连锁'益处。
depression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

depression.sentenceEn: Other reasons, according to the study, include personal fulfillment such as staying mentally fit, preventing boredom or avoiding depression .
depression.translationZh: 研究显示，其他原因还包括个人成就感，例如保持思维活跃、排解无聊或避免抑郁。
depression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

depression.sentenceEn: One Gallup poll found that 20 percent of Americans who have been unemployed for at least a year report having depression , double the rate for working Americans.
depression.translationZh: 盖洛普的一项民意调查发现，失业至少一年的美国人中有20%报告患有抑郁症，这一比例是在职美国人的两倍。
depression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

depression.sentenceEn: But to win over these young workers, manufacturers have to clear another major hurdle: parents, who lived through the worst US economic downturn since the Great Depression , telling them to avoid the factory.
depression.translationZh: 但是要赢得这些年轻工人的青睐，制造商还必须克服另一个重大障碍：那些经历过美国自大萧条以来最严重经济衰退的父母们，会告诫他们的孩子远离工厂。
depression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

depression.sentenceEn: During the Depression and the war, Americans had learned to live with less, and that restraint, in combination with the postwar confidence in the future, made small, efficient housing positively stylish.
depression.translationZh: 在大萧条和战争时期，美国人已经学会了简朴生活，这种克制再加上战后对未来的信心，使得小巧高效的住房成为绝对的时尚。
depression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

depression.sentenceEn: They should try to prevent parental depression .
depression.translationZh: 他们应该努力预防父母抑郁。

disappear.sentenceEn: As of May, those rates had spiked up to 13.3 per cent and 13.7 per cent, and although many worker shortages had disappeared , not all had done so.
disappear.translationZh: 截至5月，两国失业率已分别飙升至13.3%和13.7%，尽管许多劳动力短缺问题已不复存在，但并非所有短缺都已缓解。
disappear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

disappear.sentenceEn: A cynic might speculate that the UK is on the verge of disappearing into an endless fever of self-celebration in its desperation to reinvent itself for the post-Brexit world: after town of culture, who knows what will follow—village of culture?
disappear.translationZh: 持怀疑态度者可能会推测，英国正急于在后脱欧时代重塑自身形象，因此近乎陷入一种无休止的自我庆祝狂热：继文化之镇后，谁知道接下来会是什么——文化之村？
disappear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

disappear.sentenceEn: Worse, the crucial income to feed yourself and your family and pay the bills has disappeared .
disappear.translationZh: 更糟糕的是，用于养活自己和家人、支付各种账单的关键收入来源消失了。
disappear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

disappear.sentenceEn: As Davidson notes, "In the 10 years ending in 2009, [U.S.] factories shed workers so fast that they erased almost all the gains of the previous 70 years; roughly one out of every three manufacturing jobs – about 6 million in total – disappeared ."
disappear.translationZh: 正如戴维森所指出的：“在截至2009年的10年间，美国工厂裁员速度之快，几乎抹去了前70年积累的所有就业增长；大约三分之一的制造业岗位——总计约600万个——消失了。”
disappear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

disappear.sentenceEn: At the beginning of the century songbirds were supposed to be disappearing .
disappear.translationZh: 本世纪初，人们普遍认为鸣禽正在逐渐消失。
disappear.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

dramatic.sentenceEn: Through carefully selected words and phrases, poems can be dramatic , funny, beautiful, moving and inspiring.
dramatic.translationZh: 通过精心挑选的词语和短语，诗歌可以充满戏剧性、幽默风趣、优美动人、感人肺腑且鼓舞人心。
dramatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

dramatic.sentenceEn: To realize how great was the dramatic activity, we must remember further that hosts of plays have been lost, and that probably there is no author of note whose entire work has survived.
dramatic.translationZh: 要理解当时戏剧活动的繁荣程度，我们还必须记住：大量剧本已然散佚，而任何一位知名剧作家的作品恐怕都未能完整留存。
dramatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

dramatic.sentenceEn: Court, school, organizations of amateurs, and the traveling actors were all rivals in supplying a widespread desire for dramatic entertainment; and no boy who went to a grammar school could be ignorant that the drama was a form of literature which gave glory to Greece and Rome and might yet bring honor to England.
dramatic.translationZh: 宫廷、学校、业余剧团以及巡回演员都竞相满足人们对戏剧娱乐的广泛需求；任何上过文法学校的男孩都不会不知道，戏剧是一种曾为希腊和罗马带来荣耀的文学形式，或许也能为英格兰带来荣誉。
dramatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

dramatic.sentenceEn: The same dramatic technological changes that have provided marketers with more (and more diverse) communications choices have also increased the risk that passionate consumers will voice their opinions in quicker, more visible, and much more damaging ways.
dramatic.translationZh: 同样剧烈的技术变革在为营销人员提供更多（且更多样化）传播选择的同时，也增加了风险——情绪激动的消费者会以更快、更公开且破坏力大得多的方式表达他们的观点。
dramatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

dramatic.sentenceEn: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets.
dramatic.translationZh: 限制商业方法专利申请将会是一个戏剧性的态度转变，因为正是联邦巡回法院自己在1998年所谓的"道富银行案"判决中引入了这类专利，批准了一项共同基金资产池管理方法的专利。
dramatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

dramatic.sentenceEn: The longest bull run in a century of art-market history ended on a dramatic note with a sale of 56 works by Damien Hirst, Beautiful Inside My Head Forever, at Sotheby's in London on September 15th 2008.
dramatic.translationZh: 2008年9月15日，在伦敦苏富比拍卖行举办的"美丽永驻我心"专场拍卖会上，达米恩·赫斯特的56件作品成功售出，为艺术市场百年历史上持续时间最长的牛市画上了戏剧性的句号。
dramatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

democracy.sentenceEn: "The Heart of the Matter," the just-released report by the American Academy of Arts and Sciences (AAAS), deserves praise for affirming the importance of the humanities and social sciences to the prosperity and security of liberal democracy in America.
democracy.translationZh: 美国艺术与科学院（AAAS）刚刚发布的报告《问题的核心》因其肯定人文与社会科学对美国自由民主的繁荣和安全的重要性而值得称赞。
democracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

democracy.sentenceEn: The jury is also said to be the best surviving example of direct rather than representative democracy .
democracy.translationZh: 陪审团也被认为是现存最能体现直接民主而非代议制民主的典范。
democracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

democracy.sentenceEn: In a direct democracy , citizens take turns governing themselves, rather than electing representatives to govern for them.
democracy.translationZh: 在直接民主制度中，公民轮流自我治理，而非选举代表代其治理。
democracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

democracy.sentenceEn: On the one hand, it provides opportunities to analyze such ideas as justice, democracy and freedom.
democracy.translationZh: 一方面，它为分析正义、民主和自由等理念提供了机会。
democracy.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
democracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

democracy.sentenceEn: Egalitarian sentiments were often tempered by fears that the mass of the population was unprepared for self-rule and democracy .
democracy.translationZh: 然而，平等主义情绪常常因一种担忧而有所缓和，即广大民众尚未准备好迎接自治与民主。
democracy.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
democracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

democracy.sentenceEn: Without the ability to think critically, to defend their ideas and understand the ideas of others, they cannot fully participate in our democracy .
democracy.translationZh: 如果没有批判性思考的能力，不能捍卫自己的观点并理解他人的观点，他们就无法充分参与我们的民主。
democracy.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
democracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

dependent.sentenceEn: In adolescence, helpless and dependent children who have relied on grown-ups for just about everything become independent people who can take care of themselves and help each other.
dependent.translationZh: 在青春期，曾经事事依赖成年人的无助孩童，会转变为能够自理并互助的独立个体。
dependent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

dependent.sentenceEn: While few craftsmen or farmers, let alone dependents and servants, left literary compositions to be analyzed, it is obvious that their views were less fully intellectualized.
dependent.translationZh: 虽然几乎没有工匠或农夫——更不用说家属和仆人了——留下可供分析的文字作品，但显然他们的观点远未达到充分的理性化。
dependent.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
dependent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

dependent.sentenceEn: Forty-four states have lotteries, 29 have casinos, and most of these states are to varying degrees dependent on – you might say addicted to – revenues from wagering.
dependent.translationZh: 美国44个州发行彩票，29个州设有赌场，而这些州中的大多数都在不同程度上依赖——甚至可以说沉溺于——博彩业带来的收入。
dependent.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
dependent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

dependent.sentenceEn: Rich economies are also less dependent on oil than they were, and so less sensitive to swings in the oil price.
dependent.translationZh: 富裕经济体对石油的依赖程度也比以往有所降低，因此对油价波动的敏感度也随之下降。
dependent.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
dependent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

dependent.sentenceEn: As a result of all these factors, governments are becoming increasingly dependent on biologists and social scientists for planning the appropriate programs and putting them into effect.
dependent.translationZh: 由于所有这些因素，各国政府在制定和实施适当计划时，正变得越来越依赖生物学家和社会科学家。
dependent.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
dependent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

dependent.sentenceEn: In any case, all such interventions are heavily dependent on scientific advice and also scientific and technological manpower of all kinds.
dependent.translationZh: 无论如何，所有这类干预措施都在很大程度上依赖于科学咨询以及各类科技人才。
dependent.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
dependent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

desirable.sentenceEn: "The American Medical Association advises physicians that 'in situations where clear evidence of substantial driving impairment implies a strong threat to patient and public safety, and where the physician's advice to discontinue driving privileges is ignored, it is desirable and ethical to notify the Department of Motor Vehicles,'" Menke wrote.
desirable.translationZh: 门克写道：'美国医学协会建议医生，'当有明确证据表明驾驶员存在严重驾驶障碍，对患者本人及公共安全构成严重威胁，且医生关于终止驾驶特权的建议被忽视时，通知机动车管理部门是可取且符合伦理的做法。'
desirable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

desirable.sentenceEn: In a 2019 survey of University of Georgia students, meanwhile, the career office found the most desirable trait in a future employer was the ability to offer secure employment (followed by professional development and training, and then inspiring purpose).
desirable.translationZh: 与此同时，乔治亚大学就业指导办公室在2019年对本校学生的一项调查中发现，未来雇主最令人向往的特质是能够提供稳定的工作（其次是专业发展和培训，然后是鼓舞人心的目标）。
desirable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

desirable.sentenceEn: To find out, the researchers controlled for various factors that might make firms more likely to invest – like size, industry, and sales – and for indicators that a place was desirable to live in, like growth in wages or population.
desirable.translationZh: 为了找出答案，研究人员控制了可能促使企业增加投资的各种因素——如企业规模、行业和销售额——以及衡量一个地方宜居性的指标，如工资增长或人口增长。
desirable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

desirable.sentenceEn: In his Case Study House, Ralph Rapson may have mispredicted just how the mechanical revolution would impact everyday life – few American families acquired helicopters, though most eventually got clothes dryers – but his belief that self-sufficiency was both desirable and inevitable was widely shared.
desirable.translationZh: 在其案例研究住宅中，拉尔夫·拉普森或许错误预测了机械革命对日常生活的影响——尽管大多数美国家庭最终用上了烘干机，但拥有直升机的家庭寥寥无几——然而他关于自给自足既值得向往又不可避免的理念却得到了广泛认同。
desirable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

desirable.sentenceEn: Sharpening judgment by absorbing and reflecting on law is a desirable component of a journalist's intellectual preparation for his or her career.
desirable.translationZh: 通过理解和思考法律来提高判断力，是记者为其职业生涯进行知识准备的重要组成部分。
desirable.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
desirable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

desirable.sentenceEn: Nor, if regularity and conformity to a standard pattern are as desirable to the scientist as the writing of his papers would appear to reflect, is management to be blamed for discriminating against the "odd balls" among researchers in favor of more conventional thinkers who "work well with the team".
desirable.translationZh: 如果科学家的论文所反映出的那样，他们确实向往规律性和符合标准模式，那么管理层歧视研究人员中的“异类”，而青睐那些“善于团队合作”的传统思维者，也就无可指责了。
desirable.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
desirable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

distinction.sentenceEn: Plays aiming at literary distinction were written for schools or court, or for the choir boys of St. Paul's and the royal chapel, who, however, gave plays in public as well as at court.
distinction.translationZh: 追求文学造诣的戏剧作品当时多为学校、宫廷或圣保罗大教堂与皇家礼拜堂的唱诗班男孩们而作，不过这些唱诗班男孩们不仅在宫廷演出，也会进行公开表演。
distinction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

distinction.sentenceEn: But this distinction misses the point that it is processing and aggregation, not the mere possession of bits, that gives the data value.
distinction.translationZh: 但这种区分忽略了一个关键点：赋予数据价值的是对数据的处理和整合，而非仅仅拥有这些数据。
distinction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

distinction.sentenceEn: Before explaining the connection to the Obamacare, it is worth making an important distinction .
distinction.translationZh: 在解释这一现象与奥巴马医改的关联之前，有必要先明确一个重要的区别。
distinction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

distinction.sentenceEn: This distinction is so much so that where the latter is lacking, as it is for these unlikely gardeners, the former becomes all the more urgent.
distinction.translationZh: 这种区别如此显著，以至于当后者（即动物对庇护所的需求）无法得到满足时——正如这些特殊的园艺者（指无家可归者）的情况一样——前者（即人类对安宁圣地的需求）就变得愈发迫切。
distinction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

distinction.sentenceEn: No clear-cut distinction can be drawn between professionals and amateurs in science: exceptions can be found to any rule.
distinction.translationZh: 在科学领域，专业人士与业余爱好者之间并无明确界限：任何规则都有例外。
distinction.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
distinction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

distinction.sentenceEn: If ambition is to be well regarded, the rewards of ambition—wealth, distinction , control over one's destiny—must be deemed worthy of the sacrifices made on ambition's behalf.
distinction.translationZh: 要让人们正面看待雄心壮志，那么它所带来的回报——财富、声誉、掌控自身命运的能力——必须被认为值得人们为其所做出的牺牲。
distinction.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
distinction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

distribution.sentenceEn: The resulting settlement maps show how the distribution and density of the rural population around the city changed dramatically between AD 500 and 850, when Copán collapsed.
distribution.translationZh: 由此产生的定居点地图显示，在公元500年至850年科潘城衰落期间，该城市周边农村人口的分布和密度发生了巨大变化。

distribution.sentenceEn: Here, too, the problems are social: the organization and distribution of food, wealth and prosperity.
distribution.translationZh: 然而，这里的问题也具有社会性：粮食、财富和资源的组织与分配方式。
distribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

distribution.sentenceEn: The networked computer is an amazing device, the first media machine that serves as the mode of production, means of distribution , site of reception, and place of praise and critique.
distribution.translationZh: 联网计算机是一种了不起的设备，它是第一台集生产方式、传播手段、接收平台以及评论场所于一体的媒体机器。
distribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

distribution.sentenceEn: The value of knowledge and the return on the public investment in research depend, in part, upon wide distribution and ready access.
distribution.translationZh: 知识的价值以及公共科研投资的回报，在一定程度上取决于知识的广泛传播和便捷获取。
distribution.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
distribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

distribution.sentenceEn: Superhigh scores like vos Savant's are no longer possible, because scoring is now based on a statistical population distribution among age peers, rather than simply dividing the mental age by the chronological age and multiplying by 100.
distribution.translationZh: 像沃斯·莎凡特那样的超高智商分数已不再可能出现，因为现在的评分是基于同龄人群体的统计分布，而非简单地用心理年龄除以实际年龄再乘以100。
distribution.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
distribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

district.sentenceEn: The Chesapeake draws from a 64,000-square-mile watershed that extends into Virginia, Pennsylvania, New York, West Virginia, the District of Columbia and Delaware.
district.translationZh: 切萨皮克湾的流域面积达64,000平方英里，延伸至弗吉尼亚州、宾夕法尼亚州、纽约州、西弗吉尼亚州、哥伦比亚特区和特拉华州。
district.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

district.sentenceEn: At issue before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit was the latest take of the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) on net neutrality, adopted on a party-line vote in 2017.
district.translationZh: 提交给美国哥伦比亚特区巡回上诉法院的争议焦点是联邦通信委员会（FCC）于2017年通过党派投票方式采纳的最新网络中立性政策。
district.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

district.sentenceEn: Another nationwide concern is whether public funds from other agencies are going into construction in fire-prone districts .
district.translationZh: 另一个全国性担忧是，其他机构的公共资金是否正投入到火灾易发区的建设中。
district.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

district.sentenceEn: Except in the District of Columbia, non-lawyers may not own any share of a law firm.
district.translationZh: 除哥伦比亚特区外，非律师不得拥有律师事务所的任何股份。
district.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

district.sentenceEn: Generally however British land artists preferred to get away from towns, gravitating towards landscapes that are traditionally considered beautiful such as the Lake District or the Wiltshire Downs.
district.translationZh: 然而，英国地景艺术家总体上更倾向于远离城镇，被那些传统意义上的美景所吸引，例如湖区或威尔特郡丘陵。
district.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

district.sentenceEn: If the district finds homework to be unimportant to its students' academic achievement, it should move to reduce or eliminate the assignments, not make them count for almost nothing.
district.translationZh: 如果学区认为家庭作业对学生的学业成绩并不重要，就应该采取措施减少或取消家庭作业，而不是让它在成绩中所占的比重变得微乎其微。
district.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

divorce.sentenceEn: Divorce is legal and easy to obtain, but not common.
divorce.translationZh: 离婚是合法的，也容易办理，但并不常见。
divorce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

divorce.sentenceEn: Sociologist Catherine Kohler Riessman reports in her new book Divorce Talk that most of the women she interviewed – but only a few of the men – gave lack of communication as the reason for their divorces .
divorce.translationZh: 社会学家凯瑟琳·科勒·里斯曼在其新书《离婚谈话》中指出，她采访的大多数女性——而只有少数男性——将缺乏沟通视为离婚的原因。
divorce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

divorce.sentenceEn: The three Ds – death, debt and divorce – still deliver works of art to the market.
divorce.translationZh: 三D因素——死亡(death)、债务(debt)和离婚(divorce)——仍然在为市场输送艺术品。
divorce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

divorce.sentenceEn: Given the current divorce rate of nearly 50 percent, that amounts to millions of cases in the United States every year – a virtual epidemic of failed conversation.
divorce.translationZh: 鉴于目前近50%的离婚率，这意味着美国每年有数百万起离婚案例——可以说这是一场由沟通失败引发的流行病。
divorce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

divorce.sentenceEn: In the past decade, the Japanese divorce rate, while still well below that of the United States, has increased by more than 50 percent, and suicides have increased by nearly one-quarter.
divorce.translationZh: 在过去十年中，日本的离婚率虽然仍远低于美国，但已上升了50%以上，自杀率也增长了近四分之一。
divorce.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
divorce.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

dominate.sentenceEn: Still, AI also has the potential hazard of dominating our experiences in ways we might find difficult to control.
dominate.translationZh: 尽管如此，AI 仍存在潜在风险，即可能以我们难以掌控的方式主导我们的体验。
dominate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

dominate.sentenceEn: Microsoft's own Office dominates the market for "productivity" software, but the start-ups represented a new wave of technology designed from the ground up for the smartphone world.
dominate.translationZh: 微软自家的Office软件主导着"生产力"软件市场，但这些初创公司代表了为智能手机世界从头打造的新一轮技术浪潮。
dominate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

dominate.sentenceEn: There is a good reason why the UK is dominated by animal husbandry: most of its terrain doesn't have the right soil or climate to grow crops on a commercial basis.
dominate.translationZh: 英国畜牧业占据主导地位是有充分原因的：该国大部分地区的土壤和气候条件并不适合进行商业化农作物种植。
dominate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

dominate.sentenceEn: That would be the people who buy advertising from them – and Facebook and Google, the two virtual giants, dominate digital advertising to the disadvantage of all other media and entertainment companies.
dominate.translationZh: 他们的客户是那些从他们那里购买广告的人——而脸书和谷歌这两大虚拟巨头则主导着数字广告市场，这对其他所有媒体和娱乐公司都不利。
dominate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

dominate.sentenceEn: He was searching for tiny engraved seals attributed to the ancient Mycenaean culture that dominated Greece from the 1400s to 1200s BC.
dominate.translationZh: 他在寻找一些刻有图案的小印章，这些印章被认为属于公元前14世纪至12世纪统治希腊的古迈锡尼文明。

dominate.sentenceEn: Third, they now dominate left-of-centre politics.
dominate.translationZh: 第三，他们如今在中左翼政治中占据主导地位。
dominate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

driving.sentenceEn: Climate change is a driving factor in the push to restore forests, but it also raises questions, such as where trees can thrive in the future.
driving.translationZh: 气候变化是推动森林恢复的一个驱动因素，但也引发了一些问题，例如未来哪些地方适合树木生长。
driving.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

driving.sentenceEn: "The American Medical Association advises physicians that 'in situations where clear evidence of substantial driving impairment implies a strong threat to patient and public safety, and where the physician's advice to discontinue driving privileges is ignored, it is desirable and ethical to notify the Department of Motor Vehicles,'" Menke wrote.
driving.translationZh: 门克写道：'美国医学协会建议医生，'当有明确证据表明驾驶员存在严重驾驶障碍，对患者本人及公共安全构成严重威胁，且医生关于终止驾驶特权的建议被忽视时，通知机动车管理部门是可取且符合伦理的做法。'
driving.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

driving.sentenceEn: Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, input from past driving experiences, and what their eyes and ears tell them in that moment.
driving.translationZh: 他们的反应可能是瞬时 reflexes、过往驾驶经验的积累以及当时视听信息的复杂综合。
driving.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

driving.sentenceEn: On these sorts of trips it's easy to lose concentration on the driving and pay little attention to the passing scenery.
driving.translationZh: 在这类旅程中，我们很容易在驾驶时走神，对沿途的风景也心不在焉。
driving.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

driving.sentenceEn: Social psychologists have amassed oceans of research into what they call the "above average effect", or "illusory superiority", and shown that, for example, 70% of us rate ourselves as above average in leadership, 93% in driving and 85% at getting on well with others – all obviously statistical impossibilities.
driving.translationZh: 社会心理学家已积累了海量关于他们称之为“高于平均水平效应”或“虚幻优越感”的研究，并指出，例如，70%的人认为自己的领导力高于平均水平，93%的人认为自己的驾驶能力高于平均水平，85%的人认为自己与人相处的能力高于平均水平——这些在统计学上显然都是不可能的。
driving.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

driving.sentenceEn: A history of long and effortless success can be a dreadful handicap, but, if properly handled, it may become a driving force.
driving.translationZh: 一段长期且不费吹灰之力的成功史可能会成为一种可怕的障碍，但如果处理得当，它也可能转化为一种推动力。
driving.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
driving.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

deeply.sentenceEn: It is deeply uncomfortable – it's the emotional equivalent of wearing a jacket weighted with stones.
deeply.translationZh: 负罪感让人感到极度不安——就像是穿着一件装满石头的夹克衫，在情感上不堪重负。
deeply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

deeply.sentenceEn: And guilt, by prompting us to think more deeply about our goodness, can encourage humans to make up for errors and fix relationships.
deeply.translationZh: 而内疚感通过促使我们更深刻地反思自己的道德品质，可以鼓励人们弥补过失并修复关系。
deeply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

deeply.sentenceEn: The drive to discover is deeply rooted in humans, much the same as the basic drives for food or shelter, says Christopher Hsee of the University of Chicago.
deeply.translationZh: 芝加哥大学的奚恺元表示，人类探索未知的驱动力根深蒂固，与对食物或住所的基本需求大致相同。
deeply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

deeply.sentenceEn: Beethoven was a deeply political man in the broadest sense of the word.
deeply.translationZh: 从最广泛的意义上来说，贝多芬是一位极具政治性的人。
deeply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

deeply.sentenceEn: In the weeks and months that followed Mr. Hirst's sale, spending of any sort became deeply unfashionable.
deeply.translationZh: 在赫斯特拍卖会结束后的数周及数月内，任何形式的消费都变得非常不合时宜。
deeply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

deserve.sentenceEn: Karen R. Sime: While animals in captivity deserve sympathy, zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.
deserve.translationZh: 卡伦·R·赛姆：虽然圈养动物值得同情，但动物园在引导年轻人踏上相关科学道路方面发挥着重要作用。
deserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

deserve.sentenceEn: "The Heart of the Matter," the just-released report by the American Academy of Arts and Sciences (AAAS), deserves praise for affirming the importance of the humanities and social sciences to the prosperity and security of liberal democracy in America.
deserve.translationZh: 美国艺术与科学院（AAAS）刚刚发布的报告《问题的核心》因其肯定人文与社会科学对美国自由民主的繁荣和安全的重要性而值得称赞。
deserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

deserve.sentenceEn: While animals in captivity deserve sympathy, zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.
deserve.translationZh: 虽然圈养动物值得同情，但动物园在引导年轻人走上相关科学道路方面发挥着重要作用。

developer.sentenceEn: This concept has served as a central goal for curriculum developers , local school boards, business and community leaders, and policymakers ever since its introduction nearly 80 years ago.
developer.translationZh: 自近80年前被提出以来，这一概念一直是课程开发者、地方学校委员会、商业与社区领袖以及决策者们的中心目标。
developer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

developer.sentenceEn: "I think the question is, shouldn't a developer who's really building a hotel, but disguising it as not a hotel, be treated and taxed and regulated like a hotel?" Hom said.
developer.translationZh: 霍姆说：“我认为问题在于，开发商明明是在建造酒店，却把它伪装成非酒店性质的建筑，难道不应该像对待酒店一样对其进行管理、征税和监管吗？”
developer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

developer.sentenceEn: Now, with record-high home prices and historically low inventory, there's an increased urgency in such regulation, particularly among those who worry that developers will come in and buy up swaths of housing to flip for a fortune on the short-term rental market.
developer.translationZh: 如今，随着房价创下历史新高，而房屋库存量处于历史低位，此类监管的紧迫性愈发凸显，尤其是那些担心开发商会涌入市场、大量收购住房，然后在短租市场中转手牟取暴利的人们。
developer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

developer.sentenceEn: Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities—de facto hotels—to bypass taxes and regulations.
developer.translationZh: 然而，当开发商试图建造大规模短期租赁设施——实际上就是酒店——以规避税收和法规时，问题就出现了。
developer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

developer.sentenceEn: As the rules came into effect last Wednesday, property developers were rushing to file plans just before the deadline.
developer.translationZh: 随着新规于上周三正式生效，房地产开发商们纷纷赶在截止日期前提交规划申请。
developer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

diminish.sentenceEn: If left to themselves, such trends will diminish the relative strength of the English language in international education markets as the demand for educational resources in languages, such as Spanish, Arabic or Mandarin grows and international business process outsourcing in other languages such as Japanese, French and German, spreads.
diminish.translationZh: 如果任其发展，随着西班牙语、阿拉伯语或汉语普通话等语言的教育资源需求不断增长，以及日语、法语和德语等其他语言的国际业务流程外包不断扩展，这些趋势将削弱英语在国际教育市场的相对优势。
diminish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

diminish.sentenceEn: Complex international, economic, technological and cultural changes could start to diminish the leading position of English as the language of the world market, and UK interests which enjoy advantage from the breadth of English usage would consequently face new pressures.
diminish.translationZh: 复杂的国际、经济、技术和文化变革可能会开始削弱英语作为世界市场语言的领先地位，而那些因英语使用广泛而获益的英国利益集团将因此面临新的压力。
diminish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

diminish.sentenceEn: In zones of increased turbulence, the planes' wakes will decay more quickly and the effect will diminish .
diminish.translationZh: 在湍流增强的区域，飞机尾流消散速度会更快，其效果也会减弱。
diminish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

diminish.sentenceEn: Again, differences between people and the opportunity for natural selection to take advantage of it have diminished .
diminish.translationZh: 此外，人与人之间的差异以及自然选择利用这些差异的机会也已经减少。
diminish.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
diminish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

disadvantage.sentenceEn: The main disadvantage of using AI to respond to customers is that there are concerns about trusting personal interactions to machines, which could lead not only to the subsequent loss of interpersonal connections, but also to a decrease in marketing personnel.
disadvantage.translationZh: 使用人工智能回应客户的主要缺点在于，人们对于将人际互动交由机器处理存在顾虑，这不仅可能导致后续人际连接的丧失，还可能造成营销人员的减少。
disadvantage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

disadvantage.sentenceEn: Competition law as presently interpreted deals with financial disadvantage to consumers and this is not obvious when the users of these services don't pay for them.
disadvantage.translationZh: 当前所阐释的竞争法主要处理对消费者造成的经济损害问题，然而当这些服务的用户无需付费使用时，这种损害就显得不那么明显了。
disadvantage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

disadvantage.sentenceEn: That would be the people who buy advertising from them – and Facebook and Google, the two virtual giants, dominate digital advertising to the disadvantage of all other media and entertainment companies.
disadvantage.translationZh: 他们的客户是那些从他们那里购买广告的人——而脸书和谷歌这两大虚拟巨头则主导着数字广告市场，这对其他所有媒体和娱乐公司都不利。
disadvantage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

disadvantage.sentenceEn: And this becomes more of a problem when colleges don't talk about the class advantages and disadvantages of different groups of students.
disadvantage.translationZh: 而当大学不谈论不同学生群体的阶层优势和劣势时，这一问题就变得更加严重。
disadvantage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

disadvantage.sentenceEn: This, for those as yet unaware of such a disadvantage , refers to discrimination against those whose surnames begin with a letter in the lower half of the alphabet.
disadvantage.translationZh: 对于那些尚未意识到这种劣势的人来说，它指的是对那些姓氏以字母表后半部分字母开头的人的歧视。
disadvantage.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
disadvantage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

disadvantage.sentenceEn: Which of the following can be a disadvantage of search agents?
disadvantage.translationZh: 以下哪项可能是搜索代理的缺点？
disadvantage.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）

dismissal.sentenceEn: Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being.
dismissal.translationZh: 严格的解雇法规会对生产率增长产生不利影响，并阻碍繁荣发展和整体福祉。
dismissal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

dismissal.sentenceEn: In New Zealand, a 2016 private members' Bill tried to permit firms and high-income employees to contract out of the unjustified dismissal regime.
dismissal.translationZh: 在新西兰，2016年的一项私人议员法案曾试图允许企业与高收入员工通过合同约定退出不当解雇制度的约束。
dismissal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

dismissal.sentenceEn: Personal grievance procedures were designed to guard the jobs of ordinary workers from "unjustified dismissals ".
dismissal.translationZh: 个人申诉程序旨在保护普通工人的工作免遭“不当解雇”。
dismissal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

dismissal.sentenceEn: Yet mediocrity is no longer enough to justify a dismissal .
dismissal.translationZh: 然而，仅仅是平庸已不足以成为解雇的正当理由。
dismissal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

dismissal.sentenceEn: Across the Tasman Sea, Australia deals with the unjustified dismissal paradox by excluding employees earning above a specified "high-income threshold" from the protection of its unfair dismissal laws.
dismissal.translationZh: 在塔斯曼海对岸，澳大利亚通过将收入超过特定"高收入阈值"的员工排除在不公平解雇法律保护范围之外，来解决这一不合理解雇的矛盾。
dismissal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

dismissal.sentenceEn: What might be an effect of ERA's unjustified dismissal procedures?
dismissal.translationZh: 《雇佣关系法》中关于不当解雇的条款可能会产生什么影响？

disorder.sentenceEn: While hunter-gatherer children learnt from observation and imitation in mixed-age playgroups, researchers said that western "instructive teaching", where pupils are asked to sit still, may contribute to conditions such as attention deficit hyperactivity disorder .
disorder.translationZh: 研究人员指出，狩猎采集社会的儿童在混龄游戏群体中通过观察和模仿学习，而西方要求学生静坐的“指导性教学”可能会导致注意缺陷多动障碍等问题。
disorder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

disorder.sentenceEn: Tim Harford, author of Messy: The Power of Disorder to Transform Our Lives, points to a study in the early 1980s that divided undergraduates into two groups: some were advised to set out monthly goals and study activities; others were told to plan activities and goals in much more detail, day by day.
disorder.translationZh: 《混乱：无序的力量如何改变我们的生活》一书的作者蒂姆·哈福德提到20世纪80年代初的一项研究，该研究将大学生分为两组：一组被建议制定月度目标和学习活动；另一组则被要求更详细地规划每日活动和目标。
disorder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

disorder.sentenceEn: For him, order does not result from forgetting or ignoring the disorders that plague our existence; order is a necessary development, an improvement that may lead to the Greek ideal of spiritual elevation.
disorder.translationZh: 在他看来，秩序并非源于遗忘或忽视那些困扰我们生存的混乱；秩序是一种必然的发展，是一种提升，这种提升或许能达到希腊人所追求的精神升华的理想境界。
disorder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

disorder.sentenceEn: "Women are particularly susceptible to developing depression and anxiety disorders in response to stress compared to men," according to Dr. Yehuda, chief psychiatrist at New York's Veteran's Administration Hospital.
disorder.translationZh: 纽约退伍军人管理医院首席精神病学家耶胡达博士表示：“与男性相比，女性在面对压力时尤其容易患上抑郁症和焦虑症。”
disorder.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
disorder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

disorder.sentenceEn: Pushed by science, or what claims to be science, society is reclassifying what once were considered character flaws or moral failings as personality disorders akin to physical disabilities.
disorder.translationZh: 在科学（或者那些自称为科学的事物）的推动下，社会正将过去被视为性格缺陷或道德过失的问题重新归类为类似于身体残疾的人格障碍。
disorder.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
disorder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

disorder.sentenceEn: And a significant number of the homeless have serious mental disorders .
disorder.translationZh: 而且相当多的无家可归者患有严重的精神疾病。
disorder.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
disorder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

distance.sentenceEn: It will allow for a reduction of the distance between high-speed trains travelling on the same line at any given time, which should mean a significant increase in capacity and traffic fluidity, according to Giuricin.
distance.translationZh: 朱里钦表示，这将缩短在同一线路上行驶的高铁列车之间的追踪间隔，意味着运输能力和交通流畅度都将得到显著提升。
distance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

distance.sentenceEn: When finding their way to waterholes, they headed off in exactly the right direction, on one occasion from a distance of roughly thirty miles.
distance.translationZh: 在寻找水源地时，它们总能准确地朝着正确方向出发，有一次甚至是从约30英里外的地方直接前往。
distance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

distance.sentenceEn: Increase time, distance , and intensity gradually.
distance.translationZh: 逐步增加运动时间、距离和强度。
distance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

distance.sentenceEn: Of course, I need to concede that my collection of 'Smiling Victorians' makes up only a tiny percentage of the vast catalogue of photographic portraiture created between 1840 and 1900, the majority of which show sitters posing miserably and stiffly in front of painted backdrops, or staring absently into the middle distance .
distance.translationZh: 当然，我必须承认，我收集的这些'微笑的维多利亚人'照片，只占1840至1900年间浩如烟海的人像摄影作品中的极小一部分。绝大多数照片中的人物都在彩绘背景前摆着痛苦而僵硬的姿势，或是茫然地凝视着远方。
distance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

distance.sentenceEn: Said one recorder of events, "The air at twelve leagues' distance smelt as sweet as a new-blown garden."
distance.translationZh: 一位事件记录者曾写道：“在十二里格之外，空气闻起来就像新开的花园一样芬芳。”
distance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

distance.sentenceEn: Whether the separation distances involved would satisfy air-traffic-control regulations is another matter, although a working group at the International Civil Aviation Organisation has included the possibility of formation flying in a blueprint for new operational guidelines.
distance.translationZh: 尽管国际民用航空组织的一个工作组已将编队飞行的可能性纳入新的操作指南蓝图，但相关的间隔距离是否符合空中交通管制规定仍是另一个问题。
distance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

distribute.sentenceEn: Reform wants to ask how power and resources should be distributed in our health system.
distribute.translationZh: 改革想要探讨我们的医疗体系中权力和资源应如何分配。
distribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

distribute.sentenceEn: The African savanna elephant, also known as the African bush elephant, is distributed across 37 African countries.
distribute.translationZh: 非洲草原象，也被称为非洲丛林象，分布在37个非洲国家。
distribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

distribute.sentenceEn: He asked Jackson to print out large copies and distributed them, along with reproductions of Moran's paintings, to each member of Congress.
distribute.translationZh: 他请杰克逊冲印了大幅照片，并将这些照片连同莫兰画作的复制品一起分发给每位国会议员。

distribute.sentenceEn: Branch points out that, even if a growing number of official guidelines and textbooks reflect scientific consensus on climate change, unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers.
distribute.translationZh: 布兰奇指出，即便越来越多的官方指南和教科书反映了气候变化方面的科学共识，但一些传达更具倾向性观点的非官方教育材料仍在向教师们传播。
distribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

distribute.sentenceEn: A Knight Foundation focus-group survey of young people between ages 14 and 24 found they use " distributed trust" to verify stories.
distribute.translationZh: 奈特基金会针对14至24岁年轻人开展的焦点小组调查发现，他们会运用"分布式信任"来验证新闻故事的真伪。
distribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

distribute.sentenceEn: As Nature has pointed out before, there are some legitimate concerns about how science prizes – both new and old – are distributed .
distribute.translationZh: 正如《自然》杂志此前指出的那样，对于科学奖项——无论是新设立的还是历史悠久的——的分配方式，存在一些合理的担忧。
distribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

donation.sentenceEn: Williams pointed to rising production costs and declining attendee donations as primary reasons the Silver Room Block Party could not continue, highlighting a reality that all street festival organizers face right now.
donation.translationZh: 威廉姆斯指出，生产成本的上升和参与者捐款的减少是“银屋街头派对”难以为继的主要原因，这凸显了当前所有街头艺术节组织者共同面临的现实。
donation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

donation.sentenceEn: Despite the turnout, gate donations reached their lowest point in our history.
donation.translationZh: 尽管到场人数不少，但门票捐赠额却降至了我们历史上的最低点。
donation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

donation.sentenceEn: At the same time, donations at festival gates have dropped dramatically.
donation.translationZh: 与此同时，节日入口处的捐款数额大幅下降。
donation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

donation.sentenceEn: The fact is, unlike those large, city-produced music festivals, your neighborhood street festivals receive no city funding and rely on a combination of sponsorships, vendor fees and gate donations to cover their costs.
donation.translationZh: 事实上，与那些由城市主办的大型音乐节不同，你家门口的社区街道节庆活动得不到任何城市拨款，只能依靠赞助、摊位费和入场捐款来维持运营。
donation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

donation.sentenceEn: We often hear people ask why we solicit donations at our entry points, especially when the city's largest festivals like the Chicago Jazz Festival do not request donations .
donation.translationZh: 我们经常听到人们询问，为什么我们要在大门入口处募集捐款，尤其是在像芝加哥爵士音乐节这样的大型城市节日都不要求捐赠的情况下。
donation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

donation.sentenceEn: they are unable to use the donations wisely.
donation.translationZh: 他们无法明智地利用这些捐款。

drama.sentenceEn: By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama , and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy.
drama.translationZh: 在莎士比亚出生之际，欧洲正见证着宗教戏剧的衰落，以及在古典悲剧与喜剧的启发下新戏剧形式的诞生。
drama.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

drama.sentenceEn: Court, school, organizations of amateurs, and the traveling actors were all rivals in supplying a widespread desire for dramatic entertainment; and no boy who went to a grammar school could be ignorant that the drama was a form of literature which gave glory to Greece and Rome and might yet bring honor to England.
drama.translationZh: 宫廷、学校、业余剧团以及巡回演员都竞相满足人们对戏剧娱乐的广泛需求；任何上过文法学校的男孩都不会不知道，戏剧是一种曾为希腊和罗马带来荣耀的文学形式，或许也能为英格兰带来荣誉。
drama.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

drama.sentenceEn: The development of the Elizabethan drama for the next twenty-five years is of exceptional interest to students of literary history, for in this brief period we may trace the beginning, growth, blossoming, and decay of many kinds of plays, and of many great careers.
drama.translationZh: 伊丽莎白时期戏剧在接下来二十五年的发展，对于文学史研究者而言具有非凡的意义，因为在这短暂的时期内，我们可以追溯到多种戏剧类型以及众多伟大职业生涯的开端、成长、繁荣与衰落。
drama.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

drama.sentenceEn: These new forms were at first mainly written by scholars and performed by amateurs, but in England, as everywhere else in western Europe, the growth of a class of professional actors was threatening to make the drama popular, whether it should be new or old, classical or medieval, literary or farcical.
drama.translationZh: 这些新形式最初主要由学者创作，由业余爱好者表演，但在英国，如同西欧其他各地一样，职业演员阶层的兴起正推动戏剧走向大众化，无论其是新是旧、古典还是中世纪、文学性还是滑稽性。
drama.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

drama.sentenceEn: A native literary drama had been created, its alliance with the public playhouses established, and at least some of its great traditions had been begun.
drama.translationZh: 一种本土文学戏剧已然诞生，它与公共剧院的联盟关系业已确立，其伟大传统中至少有一部分也已开端。
drama.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

drama.sentenceEn: Shakespeare's lifetime was coincident with a period of extraordinary activity and achievement in the drama .
drama.translationZh: 莎士比亚的一生恰逢戏剧艺术空前活跃和成就斐然的时期。
drama.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

dynamics.sentenceEn: His compositions demand the performer to show courage, for example in the use of dynamics .
dynamics.translationZh: 他的作品要求演奏者展现出勇气，例如在力度的运用上。
dynamics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

dynamics.sentenceEn: But in her new book Join the Club, Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure, in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics to help individuals improve their lives and possibly the world.
dynamics.translationZh: 但在蒂娜·罗森伯格的新书《加入俱乐部》中，她提出同侪压力也可以成为一种积极力量，这要通过她所说的“社会治疗”来实现——即组织机构和官员利用群体动态的力量来帮助个人改善生活，甚至可能改善整个世界。
dynamics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

dynamics.sentenceEn: Closer inspection reveals important differences among the biggest national markets, especially in their customer segments and wholesale structures, as well as the competitive dynamics of individual food and drink categories.
dynamics.translationZh: 然而，仔细观察会发现欧洲主要国家市场之间存在显著差异，特别是在客户细分、批发结构以及各类食品饮料的竞争动态方面。

dynamics.sentenceEn: Building on this basic truth about interpersonal influence, the researchers studied the dynamics of social influence by conducting thousands of computer simulations of populations, manipulating a number of variables relating to people's ability to influence others and their tendency to be influenced.
dynamics.translationZh: 基于这一人际影响的基本事实，研究人员通过对人群进行数千次计算机模拟，操纵了若干与人们影响他人的能力以及被他人影响的倾向相关的变量，以此来研究社会影响的动态变化。
dynamics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

dynamics.sentenceEn: Moreover, average overall margins are higher in wholesale than in retail; wholesale demand from the food service sector is growing quickly as more Europeans eat out more often; and changes in the competitive dynamics of this fragmented industry are at last making it feasible for wholesalers to consolidate.
dynamics.translationZh: 此外，批发业务的平均整体利润率高于零售业务；随着越来越多的欧洲人更频繁地外出就餐，食品服务行业的批发需求正在快速增长；而这个分散行业的竞争动态变化最终使批发商整合成为可能。

dynamics.sentenceEn: What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence?
dynamics.translationZh: 社会影响动态中的基本要素是什么？
